utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and Faye’s organizing the repair drive around the school schedule, so I’ll keep folks posted when the timing’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — once the time’s set, I’ll help spread it around too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’ll let you know as soon as Faye nails down the school schedule timing. Thanks, Mara!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll jot a quick list of the homes and who can help. Also, I can grab the exact address for the community hall on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep asking around for a few more helpers and spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll get the Maple Street address and keep my list short and handy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive while I’m out running errands. Sounds like Leo, Oren, and Jules have it covered too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Rosa’s handling the sign-ups and she’ll clear the details before anything goes out, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that sounds right to me — Rosa can handle the sign-ups and clear the details before anything goes out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll sort the hand tools first, then Sam can point Leo to the parts boxes. Tess can keep folks on the block in the loop with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers, then help sort the tools and carry parts over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Leo — once the hand tools are sorted, we can get you over to the parts boxes and keep everything moving on the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Leo, could you sort the hand tools on the table first? Once that’s done, I’ll point you to the parts boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a maybe on the repair drive — I just need the drop-off and timing confirmed first. If that’s set, I can see whether I can help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll confirm the drop-off time and timing for you, then we can see if it works.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive. Ira’s on word-spreading while out on errands, and Eli can follow the plan once he gets the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll stop by later, sign the sheet, and check in with Noah afterward.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that should cover it. I’ll keep things in order here, and we can compare notes when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by a bit late, but I can bring the tools I’ve got and a notepad for the parts list. Just point me to where you need me when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I just need the plan written down first, and then I’ll follow it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll keep it simple and write it down as I go. If Cleo has the supply list handy, I can check it when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few tools and lend a hand for the repair drive whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check in with Rosa to see how I can pitch in, and I’ll let Quinn know to keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll bring my tools and a notepad, and I’ll double-check we’ve got the parts list covered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, that sounds really helpful. I think we’ve got Ira and Quinn spreading the word, Oren getting things ready, and Leo has the gloves and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good — then I’ll keep my tools and notepad ready, and I’ll make sure we still have the parts list covered before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, we’ve already got gloves, tape, a few tools, Hana’s extra tools and notepad, and Jules on volunteer duty. Tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. Pia’s still a maybe, and Nell appreciated the updates too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll leave Pia as a maybe for now and keep Nell in the loop. Once we know the gaps, I’ll add the missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll pass along any drop-off details and the confirmed time once I have them. Pia said she needs those before she can decide.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — please make sure the exact address gets noted down correctly for the repair drive. Once you have the confirmed time, pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll make sure the exact address and confirmed time are passed along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got the first step ready for Dane. When he swings by, I’ll let him take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll keep the sign-up sheet ready for Sunday at the community center. Once Dane starts, we can keep the handoff moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Rosa. I’ll keep things set for Dane and let him take over when he gets here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a maybe for the repair drive, mostly because I need the drop-off and time confirmed first. If Gus’s tools help, that might make the logistics a little easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That makes sense — Gus is bringing his tools, and Hana’s bringing tools plus a notepad, so we should have a solid setup. I’ll keep checking on the drop-off time and let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — that helps. Once the drop-off time is confirmed, I can give you a firmer answer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Gus can lend a few tools, and Leo’s bringing gloves plus a couple screwdrivers. Pia still needs the drop-off details and the confirmed time before she decides.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later, sign the sheet, and then check in with Noah afterward. If Dane needs anything, he can grab gloves, tape, or a few tools and pitch in wherever Uli’s at.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for the drop-off details and confirmed time for Pia.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — Dane brings the notepad and spare tools, Mina brings the gloves and blue masking tape, and Bo handles the home list plus the community hall address on Maple Street. I’ll just double-check that we’ve got everything covered before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Looks good — I’ll keep asking around for a few more helpers, and Ira can spread the word too. We should be set once a couple more folks are in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect — I’ll wait for your update on the extra helpers, and once they’re in, we can head out with the list and hall address ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and the repair drive’s still lining up with the school schedule—Faye’s organizing it around that, so I’ll keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll just bring any tools I already have. Hana can match folks up with her notes, and Opal’s keeping track, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right—Hana’s matching folks up with her notes, and Opal’s keeping track. I’ll keep everyone posted as the school schedule gets locked in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring a box of gloves and some blue masking tape for the repair drive. Once we know what’s already covered, Cleo can fill in the remaining gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mina — I can bring over a few tools and help fill in whatever’s left. Just let me know when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll check what’s already covered and get back to you. Then Cleo can update the list with the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m handling the sign-up sheet. If you’re able to help, I can add you to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’d like to help, and I want to make sure the exact address gets noted down correctly. If needed, Bo said the exact address can be provided.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — send me the exact address, and I’ll make sure it’s noted on the sign-up sheet. I’m glad you can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got the first step ready for Dane. When he swings by, I’ll let him take it from there, and Nell can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, sounds like it’s moving along. I’ll keep an ear out too, though I might miss a beat.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. That helps — I’ll pass along anything new when it comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep Pia in the loop too. Nell’s been great about the updates, so I’ll make sure everyone stays posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll spread the word too while I’m out running errands. With Leo, Jules, and Oren pitching in, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep sharing updates and let Pia know it’s still on. Thanks for pitching in, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive. Ira’s out running errands, so they’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks. Leo, could you sort the hand tools on the table first, then I’ll point you to the parts boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the hand tools on the table first, and then you can point me to the parts boxes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ve already got gloves, tape, and a few tools on the repair drive list. Tell me what else we’ve got, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll sort the hand tools first, and Mina’s bringing the gloves and blue masking tape. Gus is bringing a few tools too, so we’re in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ve got gloves, blue masking tape, and a few tools down already. Tell me if anything else comes up, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, can you confirm the repair drive details for me—who’s doing the drop-offs, and what time are they set for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers, and I can help sort tools and carry parts over. Gus can bring a few tools and lend a hand, and Rey will listen for updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, but can you confirm the drop-offs and the time? I just want the repair drive details clear before we share them.
